## Description

Activated-carbon panel filter for odour and chemical-vapour neutralisation, catalogued in the activated-carbon category. The source publishes six face sizes from 295×595×10 mm to 595×595×21 mm, airflow figures of 2000-3600 m³/h, pressure drops of 10-15 Pa and a 60-65% arrestance figure. Carbon is contaminant-specific, so the target compound drives the media spec. From a sourcing perspective, buyers should name the target contaminant (odour, VOC or a specific vapour) and confirm the airflow and contact time. Request carbon weight and expected service life, which are not published here, before bulk ordering.
